label: Experts X6: the Doctor with the short and the large rudder

test.title: Experts X6: the Doctor with the short and the large rudder
test.purpose: The same run twice: the address as it is (the short Nelo blade under the v3 boat), then with &rudder=large.
lookFor: the drag split (Forces), the rudder's load and lamp, the time to the first mark
questions: Which rudder for these conditions, and why?
What do you feel change between them?
test.compare: Add &boat=v3 to the address for the vNext boat (sway, yaw and a rudder foil that stalls and ventilates; &rudder=large for the large blade). The Engineering instruments show the rudder, the yaw split, the drift and the wave's push.
